result.summary: The page is generally coherent, but one prominent restaurant card contains a visibly broken or missing image, creating a large blank placeholder area. Some horizontal content is clipped at the viewport edge, which may be intentional for carousels but should be verified.

issues.description: The Tokomaru Ramen Bar card displays a large gray image area with a broken-image placeholder icon instead of restaurant artwork.
issues.suggestion: Fix the image source or loading logic, and provide a fallback image or compact error state if the image cannot be loaded.

issues.description: The rightmost category and restaurant carousel cards are cut off by the screen edge, with the third restaurant name truncated mid-word.
issues.suggestion: Verify that these sections are intentionally horizontally scrollable and provide clear scroll affordance; otherwise adjust card sizing or container padding to avoid awkward clipping.
